decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, while generating card advantage with Brainstorm and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to control the board and sculpt the game in its favor. With a mix of efficient removal, card draw, and powerful threats, this deck seeks to outmaneuver and outlast its opponents in a strategic game of attrition.

The main concept of this Dark Depths combo deck is to quickly assemble the two main combo pieces, Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, in order to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck includes various tutors and land search cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to find the combo pieces efficiently. Additionally, the deck features cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to help search for specific lands and protect the combo. The deck also includes removal and disruption cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wasteland to control the game and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient and cheap spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats quickly to apply pressure. It aims to tempo out opponents by utilizing cards like Murktide Regent and Third Path Iconoclast, alongside counter spells and removal, to maintain control of the game. The deck also leverages cards like Expressive Iteration and Brazen Borrower to generate card advantage and maintain board presence. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive in its plays and force opponents to react to its threats.

The deck is designed to quickly assemble the necessary cards for a powerful combo turn that will generate a large storm count, allowing the player to cast a lethal Tendrils of Agony. The key strategy revolves around generating mana through cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, while using cantrips and tutors to find the necessary combo pieces. Thoughtseize and Duress help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Ad Nauseam and Past in Flames provide additional resources and resilience. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main concept of this Legacy Combo - Storm deck is to generate a high storm count by casting a series of low-cost spells like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Dark Ritual, before finishing off the opponent with a lethal Tendrils of Agony or Infernal Tutor. The deck also includes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly, as well as disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, aiming to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The primary focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, and Rite of Flame. By utilizing various card draw and tutoring effects, the goal is to assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful combo turn. The key win condition is casting Tendrils of Agony or Empty the Warrens to deal massive damage to the opponent. Additionally, Burning Wish allows for additional flexibility in accessing key combo pieces from the sideboard. The inclusion of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Veil of Summer helps to protect the combo from opposing interference.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a board presence of artifact creatures and utilize cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Sai, Master Thopterist, and Thought Monitor to generate value. It aims to control the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will while also maintaining card advantage with cards like Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble. The deck also utilizes fast mana sources like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal to power out its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck revolves around quickly ramping up mana with cards like Ancient Tomb and Ignoble Hierarch, then using that mana to play powerful goblin creatures like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Conspicuous Snoop. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of goblin creatures and utilize cards like Food Chain and Sling-Gang Lieutenant for additional damage and value. The overall goal is to aggressively attack the opponent with a swarm of goblins and finish them off before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures quickly while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chalice of the Void. It also has a strong equipment package with cards like Umezawa's Jitte and Kaldra Compleat, allowing for additional threats and potential for combat tricks. The deck aims to maintain control of the board through tempo plays and efficient removal spells like Solitude. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal helps accelerate the deck's game plan, allowing for explosive starts and overwhelming the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressively overwhelming the opponent with a combination of powerful goblin creatures and synergistic abilities. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to put pressure on the opponent early, while also incorporating combo pieces like Conspicuous Snoop and Muxus, Goblin Grandee to generate massive value and finish the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Sling-Gang Lieutenant provide additional utility and reach, while Ignoble Hierarch and Food Chain help ramp into bigger threats. The deck aims to apply relentless pressure and overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this Combo - Oops, All Spells! deck is to quickly and efficiently cycle through all of the spells in the deck, ultimately leading to a win condition without any lands. By using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the entire library into the graveyard, then using Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for a win. It relies on fast mana production and protection from Pact of Negation to ensure the combo goes off successfully. The deck aims to win the game in one explosive turn.

The deck focuses on executing a combo win condition by using Doomsday to stack the top of the library with Thassa's Oracle as the last card, then drawing and winning the game on the same turn. The deck includes various cards to set up and protect the combo, such as Personal Tutor, Brainstorm, and Force of Will. It also includes mana acceleration with cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to enable casting Doomsday early in the game. The goal is to assemble the combo quickly and efficiently while controlling the game with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress.
